summary: Markey co-signed a 2021 Senate ceasefire call for Gaza and voted in April 2026 to advance S.J. Res. 32 and S.J. Res. 138, blocking sales of military bulldozers and 1,000-pound bomb bodies to Israel. In his September 2026 primary victory speech he called to 'stop the bombing in Gaza' and 'slash the Pentagon budget.' Vote for Peace rated him an Ally for the general election; Massachusetts Peace Action called him a consistent opponent of arms enabling the slaughter in Gaza.
